title: Netflix adds 9.3 million subscribers in Q1 2024, blowing past estimates
summary: Netflix reported first-quarter paid net additions of 9.33 million, far above analyst expectations of roughly 5 million, bringing total memberships to 269.6 million. Revenue rose about 15% year over year to $9.37 billion and operating margin expanded sharply.

title: Netflix beats on earnings; EPS $5.28 vs $4.52 expected
summary: First-quarter diluted earnings per share came in at $5.28, ahead of the roughly $4.52 consensus. Management cited strength from the paid-sharing crackdown and the growing ad-supported tier.

title: Netflix to stop reporting quarterly subscriber numbers starting in 2025
summary: Netflix said it will no longer disclose quarterly membership figures or average revenue per member beginning in the first quarter of 2025, asking investors to focus instead on revenue, operating margin and engagement. The company framed the change as reflecting its shift beyond a pure subscriber-growth story.

title: Netflix guides Q2 revenue to about $9.49 billion, roughly in line to slightly light
summary: Netflix guided second-quarter revenue to approximately $9.49 billion, around or just below Wall Street's ~$9.5 billion estimate, and said paid net additions would be lower sequentially in Q2 due to normal seasonality.
